nodes.label: LLMAdapterFactory.create_adapter
nodes.rationale: Wraps every created adapter in ObservabilityMiddleware - there is no opt-out path for telemetry. Inferred design intent: all outbound LLM calls must be observable.

nodes.label: OpenAIAdapter.generate_response
nodes.rationale: Tenacity-retry decorator on RateLimitError/APIConnectionError/InternalServerError, exponential backoff (1,2,10), 5 attempts.

nodes.label: OpenAIAdapter.get_token_count
nodes.rationale: Local tokenization via tiktoken - no API call. Falls back to cl100k_base when model not in tiktoken registry.

nodes.label: OpenAIAdapter._build_openai_tool_schema
nodes.rationale: Builds OpenAI tool schemas from Python function signatures via inspect.signature. Maps int/float/bool/list parameter annotations to JSON schema types.

nodes.label: GeminiAdapter.generate_response
nodes.rationale: Tenacity retries only on APIError. Stores model on self.model_name (not self.model) - ObservabilityMiddleware checks both.

nodes.label: GeminiAdapter.get_token_count
nodes.rationale: Counts tokens via the genai API (client.aio.models.count_tokens) - unlike OpenAI which is local.

nodes.label: GeminiAdapter.generate_with_tools
nodes.rationale: Passes tools as a list of callables directly to the new google-genai SDK; constructs types.Content history to send tool results back.

nodes.label: ObservabilityMiddleware._log_telemetry
nodes.rationale: Computes token metrics and emits JSON log entry. Reads self.adapter.semantic_cache attribute to determine cache_status; reads self.adapter.model and falls back to self.adapter.model_name for the model field.

nodes.label: RouterManager.agenerate_stream
nodes.rationale: Failover only fires when primary fails before yielding any chunk; otherwise re-raised to avoid duplicating the start of the stream client-side.

nodes.label: RouterManager.get_token_count
nodes.rationale: Token counting is local (tiktoken for OpenAI) and the primary adapter is sufficient - no failover path.

nodes.label: StructuredGenerator._get_provider
nodes.rationale: Provider inference order: hasattr(self.adapter,'provider') -> getattr(self.adapter,'adapter',self.adapter) (peels ObservabilityMiddleware) -> class name contains 'openai' or 'gemini'.

nodes.label: Settings (pydantic-settings)
nodes.rationale: Exposes only openai_api_key, gemini_api_key, default_temperature (0.7). DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, PRIMARY_PROVIDER, FALLBACK_PROVIDER are read directly via os.getenv in main.py lifespan - missing values keep db_pool/redis_pool None and the app still starts.

nodes.label: AppState (module-level singleton)
nodes.rationale: Plain module-level singleton holding db_pool (asyncpg.Pool), redis_pool (redis.asyncio.Redis), and router_manager (RouterManager). Token accounting is intentionally not surfaced - usage block is always zeroed out.

nodes.label: _stream_generator (SSE)
nodes.rationale: Serializes chunks in OpenAI Server-Sent Events format; appends a final stop chunk and the [DONE] sentinel. Cannot change HTTP status once streaming begins, so errors are yielded gracefully inside the event stream.
